purpose: Make one append-only transactional event stream authoritative for cycle identity, provenance, comparison count, stage coverage, closure and halt eligibility.

invariants.E1: PREDECLARED event is required before CLOSED
invariants.E2: same event retry is idempotent; conflicting retry is rejected
invariants.E3: every event is canonical-hashed and chained to the previous committed event
invariants.E4: CLOSED verifies receipt SHA and required code/config/data/policy/alignment provenance
invariants.E5: score-bearing CLOSED comparison_index is strictly monotone with no gaps
invariants.E6: legacy cycles are accounted as LEGACY_UNRECONSTRUCTABLE and never evidence-complete
invariants.E7: snapshot derives pending/closed/legacy/comparison/stage coverage/frontier from events only
invariants.E8: halt below target is impossible; non-target halt requires reconciled ledger, S1-S11 coverage and empty frontier
invariants.E9: reopen after process restart reproduces identical state digest
invariants.E10: tamper or broken hash/parent chain is detected on replay
invariants.E11: SQLite transaction is the sole mutation path; no read-modify-write JSON state
